description: Weave is an open data pipeline intended to improve access to granular electricity smart-meter data from United Kingdom distribution network operators. Its README describes technical documentation and a relatively stable iteration after earlier alpha and beta releases. The repository concerns processing and publishing demand data; individual household readings and their access terms are distinct from the MIT-licensed pipeline code. Users configure source feeds and transformations; outputs are prepared consumption records at the resolution permitted by the operator. Geographic coverage follows participating UK distribution areas. A limitation is that private household data may be aggregated, delayed or access-controlled, and a published sample does not establish national coverage. The pipeline can support demand estimation and distribution-network simulations where privacy-safe load profiles are available. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model uses demand inputs, not preparing them. No smart-meter readings or pipeline installation were downloaded.
name: Weave smart-meter data pipeline
notes: G7 G7-1748. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. Code MIT; upstream smart-meter records can have privacy and provider access restrictions.
